description: This introductory Non-Conventional Institute Core (audit) course, offered by the Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, is intended to introduce the importance of mind power, meditation and positive thoughts; to give students insights and experience of these; and to preserve and disseminate this knowledge for further research and societal applications. It is qualifying in nature (Internal: 50 Marks, Total: 50 Marks).

syllabus.title: Thoughts
syllabus.body: What are thoughts, Source of thoughts, Types of thoughts, Effect of thoughts on emotional and physical health, Understanding interrelationship between thoughts and actions, Tree of consciousness, Exercises.

syllabus.title: Meditation
syllabus.body: Introduction to Meditation, Knowing the self, Understanding and connecting to the supreme, Benefits of meditation, achieving The Eight Powers using meditation, Exercises.

syllabus.title: Mind and Body Management
syllabus.body: Stress Management, Sleep management, nourishing various body organs using innate qualities of the self, exploring 7 energy centers of the body, Body Mind Detoxification, Exercises.

syllabus.title: The Law of Attraction
syllabus.body: Positive affirmations, the art of Visualization, Karma Philosophy, Happiness, Exercises.

syllabus.title: Applications
syllabus.body: Exploring various instruments to identify the mind and body health status using Karada Scan, Muse, VR headset etc., Case Study on power of thoughts - Water experiment by Masaru Emoto, SWOC analysis of the self, Exercises.

outcomes: Learn the importance of mind power, meditation, positive thoughts etc.
Gain proficiency in interdisciplinary aspects of mind power, meditation, positive thoughts etc.
Learn about mind power, meditation, positive thoughts etc. for further research and societal applications.
referenceBooks: Jagdish Chandra Hasija, "Yog ki vidhi aur sidhi".
